meta.title: QCS shows ranks per line item and next to vendor names
gaps: A separate rank displayed next to each vendor name, distinct from the per-line Rank cells
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: A separate rank displayed next to each vendor name, distinct from the per-line Rank cells

steps.note: Start an auction event on the multi-stage create flow.
Configure the event with an Auction stage.
Apply an auction pricing template before adding line items.
Create multiple line items so ranks can be checked across each line.
Invite several vendors so the QCS has multiple bidder columns and ranks.
Publish the auction so vendors can bid.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Submit a bid from the first vendor.
Confirm the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Submit a bid from a different vendor.
Confirm the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Open the comparison screen containing the vendor bids and ranking data.
Confirm the QCS contains two real vendor columns.
Assert that ranks are populated for each line item across the bidder columns.
